Exclusion criteria are described qualitatively (incomplete coverage, high motion peaks, ghosting, artifacts) without a numeric threshold.

The preprocessing method used in this paper is the conﬁgurable pipeline for the analysis of connectomes (CPAC) the spatial dimension of each image (61, 73, 61) is downsampled to (28, 28, 28). After the processing of temporal and spatial dimensions, the size of the obtained fMRI data is (28, 28, 28, 32).
ASD/TC labels are ABIDE's own site diagnoses; no ADOS/ADI-R criterion or additional validation described in this paper.

risk_of_bias.summary: Cohort and CPAC pipeline well described, with a qualitative (non-numeric) motion/artifact exclusion rule; the main classification result relies on a single 8:2 split without cross-validation, site handling or an explicit leakage-control statement.

charting.title: CNNG: A Convolutional Neural Networks With Gated Recurrent Units for Autism Spectrum Disorder Classification
charting.primary_goal: Classify ASD vs. typical controls directly from 4D spatio-temporal resting-state fMRI using a joint 3D-CNN + GRU (CNNG) deep-learning model.
charting.feature_types: Raw 4D spatio-temporal fMRI volumes (downsampled, voxel-wise, no ROI/atlas)
charting.specific_features: 28x28x28 spatial volumes x 32 timepoints, fed directly into a 3D-CNN+GRU network
charting.model_category: Deep learning (3D CNN + Gated Recurrent Unit)
charting.specific_algorithms: CNNG: stacked small 3D convolutional kernels (3x3x3) for spatial features + GRU for temporal features, compared against LSTM variant, CNN-MLP, DiagNet, HI-GCN, GAT, SVC
charting.validation_methodology: Single 8:2 train/test split (no cross-validation reported for the main result); per-site average accuracy/sensitivity/specificity also reported across the 17 sites
charting.key_performance_results: the proposed algorithm obtains an accuracy of 72.46% in the experiment of 871 subjects, which is 5.26% higher than that of HI-GCN, 4.44% higher than that of GAT, and 2.44% higher than that of CNN. The proposed algorithm also obtains a speciﬁcity of 79.25% and a sensitivity of 74.35%. the AUC value of the proposed algorithm is 0.79, which is 5.42% higher compared to GAT.
charting.summary_key_findings: CNNG achieved 72.46% accuracy, 74.35% sensitivity, 79.25% specificity and AUC 0.79 for ASD vs TC classification from raw spatio-temporal ABIDE-I fMRI, outperforming CNN-MLP, DiagNet, HI-GCN and GAT comparators.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Diagnostic prediction; ABIDE I, 17 sites, 1112 initial subjects QC'd to 871 (403 ASD/468 TC)
narrative_row.methods: CPAC-preprocessed raw 4D spatio-temporal fMRI (voxel-wise, downsampled to 28x28x28x32, no atlas) fed into a stacked small-kernel 3D-CNN + GRU network (CNNG); single 8:2 train/test split; compared against CNN-MLP, DiagNet, HI-GCN, GAT, SVC and an LSTM variant.
narrative_row.outcomes: CNNG achieved 72.46% accuracy, 74.35% sensitivity, 79.25% specificity, AUC 0.79, outperforming all deep-learning comparators tested.
narrative_row.key_limitations: Single train/test split rather than cross-validation; qualitative (non-numeric) motion/QC exclusion; no site covariate, harmonisation or leave-one-site-out evaluation despite 17-site data.
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Illustrative of voxel-wise spatio-temporal (non-atlas) deep-learning approaches to ABIDE classification, and of weak reporting on cross-validation/leakage/site handling relative to connectivity-matrix-based studies.
